description: This file defines the RegistrationService interface within the org.eclipse.hono.service.registration package. It declares methods for asserting device registration status, including checks for device existence, enabled state, and gateway authorization, often using asynchronous handlers and optional OpenTracing span support.

classes.name: RegistrationService
classes.description: An interface providing minimal device registration assertions, including methods to verify registration status and gateway authorization.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Verifies that a device is registered and enabled for a given tenant, invoking the provided handler with the result.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Default method invoking the primary assertRegistration, passing along a span for tracing if provided.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Verifies that a device is registered, enabled, and allowed to act on behalf of another device (gateway), considering gateway authorization.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Default method invoking the primary assertRegistration for gateway cases, passing along a span for tracing if provided.
